_comment: GL2.5d/e expectation matrix: what the symptom engine must find on each scenario table. Any active symptom not listed under 'expect' or 'allow' is unexpected. Findings held for workload evidence (needs-evidence) are ignored. Partition selectors: 'partitions' (exact set of partition values), 'newest' (only the table's newest partition), 'not_newest', 'min_value' (every flagged partition >= this value), 'prefix' (every flagged partition value starts with this; multi-field values are joined with '/'), 'count', 'min_count'; 'optional': true = allowed but not required (selectors still apply when it appears). 'fresh' marks a table whose check is only valid while its newest partition is younger than the hot window; past that the result is STALE, not FAIL. 'after' (optional): expectations once plan.py has applied fixes to the table (matched by table UUID, so a rebuild resets it to 'before'); an empty expect list means healthy.

expect._comment: policy-driven since GL2.6f: appears only once snapshots are older than the retention policy (batch 120 h, keep 10), so a table built in the last 5 days doesn't show it

after._comment: after make gl-plan T=s0 APPLY=1: both days compacted, old snapshots expired
one plan run compacts the top 10 of 11 flagged days; the 11th waits for the next run (at most one day left), and with 1 partition left SCATTERED clears; a second run leaves none

deletes applied to rewritten files and the old delete files removed. RETAINED_STORAGE is allowed: expiry keeps the last 10 snapshots, so the pre-compaction copy stays referenced (about 1.1x live) until the policy expires it

after._comment: past day compacted, snapshots expired, today held while hot. Today may still be hot (HOT_PARTITION), cooled but not yet compacted (SMALL_FILES, next run's work), or compacted by a second run (healthy). Anything on the past day fails.

glue.demo.s20_delete_sprawl._comment: GL2.6c: 12 single-row DELETEs with partition-scoped delete files: 12 position delete files, 0.012% of rows deleted. DELETE_FILE_SPRAWL (new_findings on): the plan merges the delete files without rewriting data.

after._comment: after make gl-plan T=s20 APPLY=1: rewrite_position_delete_files merged the 12 into one

glue.demo.s21_expiry_policy._comment: GL2.6e/f: the writer's own retention (10 min, keep 3) wins. 15 snapshots (15 appends); once 10 minutes old: SNAPSHOT_BUILDUP (11 expirable: 15 minus the newest 3 minus the tagged one), and STALE_REF once the tag is over 1 h old. Both optional so a scan in the first 10 minutes after the build passes too.

after._comment: after make gl-plan T=s21 APPLY=1 (with expiry_policy on): compacted, expired to the policy; the tag still holds its snapshot

glue.demo.s17_growing._comment: MAINTENANCE_LAG needs three scans with excess files rising (scan / make gl-step STEP=grow / scan / grow / scan); it's optional here so every scan in that sequence passes. Check the per-table output of the third scan for it. Two grow steps add 20 commits, so SNAPSHOT_BUILDUP may appear too.
